title: Reagan and Bush Debate Immigration, Border Fences, and Undocumented Children in 1980
summary: A short clip of George H. W. Bush and Ronald Reagan answering an audience question on illegal immigration at a 1980 Republican primary debate. Both take notably sympathetic positions, including on schooling for undocumented children.
why: Repeatedly posted in immigration threads to contrast 1980 Republican rhetoric with modern positions.

quote.text: Reminded me of a fascinating video I recall; Bush and Reagan debate illegal immigration in 1980's primary.
